verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor-published incident postmortems, no reference to a live Okta trust/status page, and no disclosure-history documentation — only unrelated developer docs (SSO, SCIM, MCP server) and general community sentiment about past breaches (e.g. okta-comm-1, okta-comm-10, okta-comm-13) which reflects distrust but is not a citation of Okta's own postmortem or trust-page content.
